answer: One concrete defense is a staked proof-of-work lock. Each agent must escrow a bond and complete verifiable inference jobs before it may vote or earn; a thousand puppet identities each pay that same cost, so a cheap swarm becomes a real bill. Trust climbs a slow ridge, earned only through cross-checked output, never through self-declared links, and any failed audit slashes the whole grove of linked accounts at once. That shared loss drives attacker cost far above the payoff of one forged vote, so the lagoon's ledger stays honest.
